Hi Asha,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're preparing the copy for our GCP Seller Hallmark listing and would love to feature DataFlux AI as a spotlight customer. I've attached a very short draft blurb (3–4 sentences) plus a one-line quote we pulled from your recent email.

Can you please:
- Confirm you're comfortable with the attached blurb and one-line quote for use on the GCP listing and Redwood website;
- Share any preferred edits (tone or specific wording to avoid);
- Confirm permission to use DataFlux's logo on the listing.

We're aiming to publish the listing the week of June 28, so if possible we'd need sign-off by end of day Friday (June 25). I've attached the draft for quick edits: redwood_marketplace_blurb_draft.docx.

If you prefer, we can route a short DocuSign consent instead of an email thread — whichever is easiest. Thanks in advance!

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: GCP Seller Hallmark — customer quote & short blurb approval

Thanks Mina — appreciate the heads-up and the quick draft. I took a pass and attached a PDF with a couple of redlines (dataflux_redline_comments.pdf). High-level notes:
- Please remove the specific internal metric about "20% latency reduction" — we don't want performance claims tied to a specific customer metric in marketplace collateral.
- Prefer the phrase "improved inference reliability" over latency percentage.
- Logo use is fine, subject to procurement sign-off (looping them here).

If you can update the blurb to avoid that hard stat, I'm fine with a short 2–3 sentence spotlight and a one-line quote along the lines of: "Redwood's inference runtime reduced variability and helped us ship faster."

Cc'ing procurement to take a look at the consent mechanics — they prefer a signed consent form.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform, DataFlux AI
asha.patel@dataflux.ai
Attachment: dataflux_redline_comments.pdf
